0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Bulls on the road in Toronto, and Chicago is missing Isaac Okoro (undisclosed), Nic Claxton (hamstring), Tobe Awaka (knee) and Zach Collins (toe, surgery), all listed as day-to-day. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out following Achilles surgery, while Chucky Hepburn (hamstring) is day-to-day, and Collin Murray-Boyles, Immanuel Quickley, Ja'Kobe Walter, Jakob Poeltl, Jamal Shead, Kawhi Leonard, RJ Barrett and Scottie Barnes are all listed as day-to-day with rest. The Bulls lost their 2025-26 season series 0-3, most recently 139-109 in Chicago on March 18, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Chicago a 25% chance to win.
